desc:
Race, set records and climb the global leaderboard!

Jump into fast arcade racing on real circuits. Line up on the grid, wait for the lights and fight for P1 against other players.

FEATURES
• Multiplayer races with a lights-out start
• 4 tracks: SILVERSTONE, INTERLAGOS, OVAL. Vote for the next one!
• TIME ATTACK: chase your ghost and beat your personal best
• Global leaderboards for every track, including sector times
• Track limits: cut the track and your lap won't count!
• Customize your car with exclusive paints or the free color palette
• Unlock the PROTOTYPE, a legendary endurance racer
• Private servers: pick any track for your Time Attack

CONTROLS
W/S – throttle/brake • A/D – steer • SPACE – handbrake
R – reset • C – camera • M – menu

Top the leaderboard and get your rank above your head. See you on track! 🏆
